mechanical_summary: Unlimited pierce; other values unchanged
primary_tradeoff: No direct single-target increase

mechanical_summary: Every main hit emits a perpendicular 45% Damage shockwave reaching 2.5M each side; target cap two secondary hits per shot
primary_tradeoff: Requires aligned clusters

mechanical_summary: 9 s stationary charge or 4.5 s at full speed; 175% Damage; 200% width; unlimited pierce
primary_tradeoff: Always slower than base and much slower while stationary

mechanical_summary: Every primary victim seeds a 40% Damage and 60% radius blast after 0.4 s; target cap two secondary hits
primary_tradeoff: Needs a dense primary impact and delayed occupancy

mechanical_summary: Leaves a 3 s field dealing 12% Damage every 0.5 s and slowing 30%
favorable_effect: Up to +72% full-stay damage plus control
primary_tradeoff: Moving enemies avoid much of the field

mechanical_summary: Shell centers on mech; 180% Damage; 160% radius; normal cadence
favorable_effect: Large close-range damage and coverage increase
primary_tradeoff: Loses remote safety and retains 1.2 s delay

mechanical_summary: Repeats full field once in the same location 1.25 s after original ends
primary_tradeoff: Low value against relocating targets

mechanical_summary: End burst deals 75% of full field damage budget and launches enemies 4M
primary_tradeoff: Destroys the grouping created by the field

mechanical_summary: 7 s cycle; 4 s collection at 60% DPS; mass cap 12; singularity lasts current field duration and deals Damage x (4 + 0.25 x mass) per second
favorable_effect: Infrequent high-impact zone and boss burst
primary_tradeoff: Long fixed cycle and depends on feeding mass

mechanical_summary: Permanent-drone kills create exact 8 s clones; six temporary-drone cap; clones cannot replicate
favorable_effect: Up to 3x squad size during rapid kills
primary_tradeoff: No lone-target benefit and must maintain permanent-drone kills

mechanical_summary: All drones focus one target; +15% Damage per other permanent drone locked; +30% at full squad
primary_tradeoff: Poor crowd distribution

mechanical_summary: Three rotating links; each deals 200% of one drone's current DPS; target cap two simultaneous links
primary_tradeoff: No autonomous ranged fire; requires enclosure geometry

mechanical_summary: Focus persists and decays only 10 percentage points/s while unlocked
favorable_effect: Approximately +35-55% realized damage in target-rich movement
primary_tradeoff: No increase to the 2x focus cap

mechanical_summary: At 75% focus target takes +25% all-weapon damage for 4 s and refreshes while focused
primary_tradeoff: Requires sustained focus on one target

mechanical_summary: Unlimited-pierce facing beam at full DPS; focus holds inside 12 degrees and resets beyond 25 degrees
primary_tradeoff: Manual facing and turn discipline

mechanical_summary: Instant hitscan traces dealing current Damage
favorable_effect: Eliminates travel delay and movement misses
primary_tradeoff: No ideal stationary-target DPS increase

mechanical_summary: Prefers enemies not hit in prior 1.5 s and slows 25% for 1 s
primary_tradeoff: No raw damage increase

mechanical_summary: One full-Damage pulse fires left and one right every attack event
primary_tradeoff: No target selection; strict lateral facing geometry

mechanical_summary: Each parent creates four 35% Damage and 50% radius micro-mines; nonrecursive; micro cap four times parent capacity
primary_tradeoff: Requires enemies to consume dispersed children

mechanical_summary: Waits for three ordinary equivalents or elite/boss; +15% Damage per additional equivalent capped at 2x
favorable_effect: Higher payload efficiency and up to 2x damage
primary_tradeoff: May leave holes against scattered enemies

mechanical_summary: Pursues within 6M at 3M/s for 6 s; 150% Damage; 85% radius; one retarget
primary_tradeoff: Less area and less route-defense control

mechanical_summary: All pods gain +25% attack rate per additional active pod; +50% cap
primary_tradeoff: Loses value during deployment ramp and expiration gaps

mechanical_summary: Prioritizes enemies within 4M of mech; hits push 0.8M and stagger 0.25 s
primary_tradeoff: No raw damage increase and less priority on distant threats

mechanical_summary: 1.5 s hold deploys one persistent pod at 300% Damage and 200% rate; packs beyond 6M
favorable_effect: 2x total steady DPS of three base pods
primary_tradeoff: Requires anchoring and redeployment

mechanical_summary: Hits grant +4% Damage and orbit speed; ten-stack cap; delayed stack decay
primary_tradeoff: Requires continuous close contact

mechanical_summary: Intercepts projectiles; six 50% Damage shards; target cap two shards; 0.5 s cutter cooldown
primary_tradeoff: Depends on interceptable enemy fire

mechanical_summary: One delayed-path blade at 200% size and 200-400% Damage based on blade speed; 0.5 s target repeat
favorable_effect: Up to 2x base single-target ceiling and strong path slicing
primary_tradeoff: Must steer a 0.5 s trailing blade at speed

mechanical_summary: Removes five-target cap; no repeat target in one arc
primary_tradeoff: No direct single-target increase and needs chain density

mechanical_summary: Stagger starts at 0.25 s and gains 0.05 s per chain step capped at 0.60 s
primary_tradeoff: No raw damage increase and boss resistance applies

mechanical_summary: 0.4/s base orb launch; 4 s life; arcs twice/s to three targets for current Damage
favorable_effect: 51.2 rank-zero ideal single-target DPS and large area potential
primary_tradeoff: Slow placement and moving targets lower realized output

mechanical_summary: Prior pulse victims charge next pulse; +2% Damage and +1% radius each; 20-charge cap
primary_tradeoff: Needs dense sustained contact; boss alone gives one charge

mechanical_summary: Pushes 1M and slows 25% for 1 s
primary_tradeoff: No raw damage increase

mechanical_summary: 25% pulse rate; 500% Damage; 250% radius; 2 s charge tell
favorable_effect: 25% higher steady single-target DPS and huge event coverage
primary_tradeoff: Six-second rank-zero gaps between pulses

mechanical_summary: After 2 s moving gains +10% Damage and +5% width per second; caps +50% and +25%; clears after 1 s nearly stopped
favorable_effect: Up to +50% trail DPS plus width
primary_tradeoff: Requires sustained traversal

mechanical_summary: Damaged enemies leave 3 s trails at 50% Damage and width; nonrecursive; shared overlap cap
favorable_effect: Turns fast enemies into moving area denial
primary_tradeoff: Value depends on enemy movement through other enemies

mechanical_summary: Closing a 4-40 square-M loop consumes segments and deals six seconds of segment Damage inside; 1 s closure cooldown
primary_tradeoff: Requires route drawing and consumes the trail

mechanical_summary: One cone wave hits every enemy once for 400% pellet Damage
primary_tradeoff: Close single-target full-volley damage falls from 5x to 4x pellet Damage

mechanical_summary: Pellets add 1.2M knockback and 0.35 s stagger; control once per target per volley
primary_tradeoff: No raw damage increase and control resistance applies

mechanical_summary: Pellets converge at maximum range and deal 140% Damage each
primary_tradeoff: Poor damage closer than focal point and facing-dependent

mechanical_summary: Above 80% speed gains one +10% Damage and +5% width stack per second; impacts grant at most one extra stack/s; six-stack cap; clears after stopping
primary_tradeoff: Requires continuous high-speed danger exposure

mechanical_summary: Rammed enemy travels up to 5M and deals 75% hit Damage to up to three new enemies; nonrecursive
favorable_effect: Up to +225% secondary crowd damage per launched enemy
primary_tradeoff: Needs collision lanes and cannot launch bosses

mechanical_summary: 1.25 s hold creates 2.2M circular barrier; crossings deal 150% Damage every 0.5 s; moving 0.5M collapses it
favorable_effect: 50% higher per-target DPS and complete perimeter coverage
primary_tradeoff: Strict anchoring requirement

mechanical_summary: Each missile splits into three 45% Damage and 50% radius micro-missiles distributed distinctly before extras
favorable_effect: +35% total direct payload with better distribution
primary_tradeoff: Smaller individual explosion area

mechanical_summary: Stores eight missiles; dives at enemies within 6M for 125% Damage; excess launches normally
favorable_effect: Banks quiet-time output and adds +25% reserve damage
primary_tradeoff: Delays ordinary long-range offense

mechanical_summary: Four radial non-homing missiles at 125% Damage and radius; launch offset advances 45 degrees; missiles curve 45 degrees/s
favorable_effect: +25% raw damage and area with predictable sweep
primary_tradeoff: No priority tracking and shots can miss empty sectors
